response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and systems engineer with deep experience in DLang, TypeScript, Node.js, and web/mobile platforms, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: substantial hands-on C++ development (only ~6 months briefly touching C/C++ at National Instruments), no Windows-platform development experience, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure despite one fintech-adjacent role (RIDE Capital) that used Node/TypeScript/GraphQL rather than C++.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering background with 15+ years of experience across many domains
Demonstrated experience with CI/CD, TDD, and dev-ops practices relevant to enterprise software delivery
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and fluent English
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months) with no evidence of 5-10 years or Windows-platform C++ development
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; only generic SQL/MySQL listed
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise despite one fintech-adjacent role using non-C++ stack

key_factors.factor: No fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
